school.school_name: 君津中央病院附属看護学校

manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Find the FY2026 renewal confirmation form when the HTML contains an empty stale PDF anchor immediately before the visible current-year anchor.
search_queries: 君津中央病院附属看護学校 令和8年度 更新確認申請書
君津中央病院附属看護学校 2026sinseisyo.pdf
steps: Find the visible link labeled 【令和８年度】更新確認申請書.
Ignore the immediately preceding empty anchor that still points at /images/stories/contents/Nursing_school/reiwa3kakunin.pdf.
Accept it as FY2026 because the visible anchor supplies target-year evidence and the PDF body contains 君津中央病院附属看護学校 plus target-form sections.

reusable_rules: Do not assign visible sibling anchor text to an empty anchor that points at a different PDF.
Prefer the visible current-year confirmation-form anchor over a preceding empty stale PDF anchor in the same block.
Accept a direct PDF when the visible anchor supplies target-year evidence and the PDF body has exact school-name plus target-form sections.
anti_patterns: Do not download a stale hidden/empty PDF only because its sibling anchor says 令和８年度.
Do not use block-wide text as evidence for an empty anchor when another visible anchor exists in that block.

evidence.notes: Manual web trace on 2026-05-13 found an empty stale PDF anchor followed by the visible 令和８年度 更新確認申請書 anchor. Before the fix, discovery accepted reiwa3kakunin.pdf; after the fix, it downloads 2026sinseisyo.pdf.
